The Magnetic manifesto

Not just trophies.
Stories worth telling.

Our mission is to build an award universe that celebrates effort, kindness, creativity, and unforgettable moments. We may be starting small, but our imagination has absolutely no chill.

★

Biggest in spirit.

Every great institution starts with an idea, a doodle, and someone brave enough to say, “What if we actually did this?”

The game plan

How legends happen.

Simple idea. Great people. A little bit of ceremony.

01

Spot the good

Notice the people making a difference, bringing the laughs, or showing up when it matters.

02

Make it official

Give the moment a name, a story, and an award worthy of remembering.

03

Celebrate loudly

Share the honour, cheer for the winner, and add another chapter to Magnetic Awards history.
